properties.name: sentinel:cbom:fips_validation_statement

properties.name: sentinel:data_lifetime

components.name: OCESCROW3-RSA-3072-OAEP-ML-KEM-768-HKDF-SHA256-AES256GCM
components.description: Transcript-bound IND-CCA2 Hybrid KEM Combiner wrapping 256-bit Quarantine Vault Master KEK

properties.name: sentinel:combiner_formula
properties.value: HKDF-SHA256(salt_16B, ss_rsa_32B || ss_mlkem768_32B, 'OMNICONNECT-HYBRID-ESCROW-V3|' || kek_id || '|' || SHA256(ct_rsa) || SHA256(ct_mlkem768))

components.name: RSA-3072-OAEP-SHA256
components.description: Classical asymmetric KEM leg in OCESCROW3 and v2 SOC escrow (>= 3072-bit RSA strictly enforced; SHA-256 OAEP exclusively, SHA-1 OAEP fallback removed)

properties.name: sentinel:retirement_schedule
properties.value: Classical-only v2 SocEscrowBlob deprecated in favor of OCESCROW3 hybrid v3; scheduled removal by 2030-12-31

components.name: AES-256-GCM

properties.name: sentinel:wire_envelopes

components.name: ECDSA-P256-SHA256

algorithmProperties.implementationPlatform: Windows TPM 2.0 PCP / CNG BCrypt when available; pure-Rust p256 v0.14.0 fallback

properties.name: sentinel:pqc_roadmap

components.name: HKDF-SHA256
